guidePresets.name: House style
guidePresets.text:
INTRO: Every episode opens on intro music. Voices enter at 6 s; the music ducks under them and fades out over about 3 s.
CTA: When the call to action begins (before the outro), play the same intro music again, lightly and low under the voices, for the whole CTA. No other background music plays during it; the outro follows.
OUTRO: Outro music enters about 2 s before the final line ends and plays for 7 s, fading out at the end.
TRANSITIONS: Use a riser or stinger when the conversation moves to a new segment or topic.
ENGAGEMENT SFX: Roughly one SFX every 45-90 s of talk, never two within 6 s. Whoosh for topic pivots and introductions, pop for quick facts or numbers, ding for key takeaways.
EMOTION: funny/laugh -> playful boing; surprise/wow/excitement -> shimmer; sad/serious -> soft drop; tension/suspense -> drone; aha/insight -> chime; win/celebration -> applause.
PRODUCT POSITIONING: Whenever the hosts present the product, its benefits, or a feel-good moment for the listener, run the feel-good positioning music under those lines: fade in 1.5 s before, fade out 2 s after.
HOSTS: Keep a light background bed (Hosts) under stretches where the two hosts talk, low and ducked under the voices.
CURIOSITY: When the guest asks a question, play the light Curiosity music under that question.
INSIGHT: When the hosts share valuable information (steps, tips, what to check, how something works), play the light Insight music under those lines.
SAVINGS: When the hosts talk about savings, paying less tax, lower EMIs or other money-wise benefits, play the happy Savings music under those lines.
CAUTION: Whenever a line warns the listener about paying taxes, fines, penalties, late fees, extra charges or other risks, play the light Caution music under that line, kept low (around -15 dB) with gentle fades. Never dramatic.
MIX: Music sits well under the voices and ducks while anyone speaks. SFX around -6 dB. Never put an SFX on top of a punchline word: place it just before or just after the line.
TTS voice tags like [laughs] or [whispers] are performance notes, not edits, but they are good hints for emotion cues.

guidePresets.name: Bajaj episode style (STCG example)
guidePresets.text:
FIXED: Every episode opens and closes with the AI disclaimer at full volume. The product disclaimer for the selected product (for example Home Loan) plays just before the closing AI disclaimer.
INTRO: Intro music starts under the host's opening hook question. Voices enter at about 6 s; the music ducks under them and fades out over about 3 s.
HOSTS: Keep the light Hosts bed (around -14 dB) under stretches where the two hosts explain or talk to each other.
GUEST INTRO: Put a whoosh just before the line that introduces the guest ("Today we have Rahul...").
GUEST: When the guest describes their situation or goal (what they invested in, what they want to buy), run the warm Guest bed under those lines (around -14 dB).
CURIOSITY: When the guest asks a question or raises a doubt ("But how much tax will I pay?"), play the light Curiosity music under that question instead of the Guest bed.
PRODUCT POSITIONING: When a host presents Bajaj Finserv, the home loan, competitive interest rates, eligibility or the EMI calculator, run the feel-good positioning music under those lines: fade in 1.5 s before, fade out 2 s after.
INSIGHT: When the hosts explain how something works (tax rates, holding periods, steps to follow, documents to keep ready), play the light Insight music under those lines.
NUMBERS: Add a soft pop just after a line that states a key number (20%, 12 months, 24 months, an amount). At most 3 per episode and at least 30 s apart.
CAUTION: Lines about tax liability, surcharge and cess, rules that differ by asset, or "don't put all your savings in the down payment" get the light Caution music, kept low (around -15 dB) with gentle fades. No SFX on caution lines.
SAVINGS: When the hosts talk about keeping funds or emergency savings aside, lower EMIs, paying less tax or other money-wise benefits, play the happy Savings music under those lines.
KEY TAKEAWAY: Add a ding just after agreement or summary moments ("Exactly, Rahul.", "Now I am clear."). At most 2 per episode, never on the final line.
CTA: When the call to action begins (before the outro), play the same intro music again, lightly and low under the voices, for the whole CTA. No other background music plays during it; the outro follows.
OUTRO: Outro music enters about 2 s before the final line ends and plays for 7 s, fading out at the end.
MIX: Music always sits under the voices and ducks while anyone speaks. SFX around -6 dB. At most one SFX every 45-90 s of talk and never two within 6 s. Never put an SFX on top of a punchline or key word: place it just before or just after the line.

guidePresets.name: Bajaj storytelling style
guidePresets.text:
FIXED: Every episode opens and closes with the AI disclaimer at full volume. The product disclaimer for the selected product plays just before the closing AI disclaimer.
INTRO: After the opening disclaimer, the intro music plays at full volume for 2.5 s and then fades out. The voices start right at 2.5 s.
STORY REWRITE: 2 s after the intro music ends, run the storytelling music "story rewrite" under the hosts' opening setup and whenever the hosts are speaking generally. Do not use Hosts Easy Lo-fi or Happy Marimba.
STORY PLAY: Whenever any speaker (host or guest) gives insightful or valuable information (the product, the application process, steps, rates, tax, eligibility, documents, income, credit, approval or any subject matter), run the storytelling music "story play". Never use Insight Bright Piano or Insight Glow.
GUEST INTRODUCTION: When the guest is introduced or welcomed ("welcome", "today we have…"), play "Character Intro – Warm Keys" just after that line. No drumroll.
GUEST: When the guest speaks (other than questions), run Guest Warm Acoustic under those lines.
CURIOSITY: Whenever any speaker (host or guest) asks a question or raises a doubt, run "Unfolding Insights" from the Curiosity category under it.
PRODUCTS (MANDATORY): Whenever a Bajaj product (home loan, personal loan, insurance and so on) is introduced, by a host or the guest, run the storytelling music "story play" under that line. This always applies and overrides any other music on that line.
PRODUCT POSITIONING: Product positioning music is always the 1BFL intro track (never Product Feel-Good Lift or Feel-Good Lift).
BENEFITS (MANDATORY): Every time low interest rates are mentioned (low, lower, competitive or attractive interest rates, "kam byaj", "interest rate kam hai", "starting at X%"), play Coin Chime (Engagement) just after that line, in every episode, even next to other SFX or on caution lines. Savings and other money benefits also get Coin Chime, at least 12 s apart.
ACKNOWLEDGEMENT: When the guest says they have understood, acknowledges and concludes ("Now I am clear", "I will follow it"), play Harp Glide at low volume just after that line.
CTA: When the call to action begins (before the outro), play the same intro music again, lightly and low under the voices, for the whole CTA. No other background music plays during it; the outro follows.
NO SILENCE: Wherever the conversation has no background music, run the storytelling music "story rewrite" (from 2 s after the intro until the outro).
ONE MUSIC AT A TIME: Never play two background music tracks at the same time. When a new music starts, the previous one stops there.
CAUTION: Lines that warn about taxes, fines, penalties or extra charges get the light Caution music, kept low (around -15 dB). No SFX on caution lines.
NUMBERS: A soft Marimba Pop may follow a line that states a key number. At most 3 per episode.
TRANSITIONS: Use Harp Glide only, at low volume (around -16 dB), and only where needed.
AVOID: No high-pitched or sharp sound effects: no risers, stingers, swells, whistles, beeps or sparkles.
OUTRO: Warm Close enters about 2 s before the final line ends and plays for 7 s, fading out at the end.
HOSTS: Keep a light background bed (Hosts) under stretches where the two hosts talk, low and ducked under the voices.
INSIGHT: When the hosts share valuable information (steps, tips, what to check, how something works), play the light Insight music under those lines.
SAVINGS: When the hosts talk about savings, paying less tax, lower EMIs or other money-wise benefits, story play (from storytelling category)music under those lines.
MIX: All background music (story rewrite, story play, Guest Warm Acoustic, Unfolding Insights, caution music, product music and the intro music under the CTA) is set to -10 dB, and the background track ducks under the voices while anyone speaks. SFX around -6 dB. Never put an SFX on top of a key word: place it just before or just after the line.
